title: Beef Tagine with Zesty Flair
description: A twist on the classic North African dish, this beef tagine is marinated in a zesty blend of spices and slow-cooked to perfection.

ingredients.name: Algerian Tagine Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets

ingredients.name: Zesty Marinade
ingredients.notes: Mix of lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and herbs

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together zesty marinade, Algerian tagine spice blend, salt, and black pepper. Add sliced beef and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Remove beef from marinade and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger to the pot and cook until onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add chicken broth and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs and lemon wedges, if desired.
